newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber up limit on rumor producer cutback.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber up limit on rumor producer cutback.

text.p: Rumors that a major Canadian lumber producer has curtailed production sent September CME lumber futures up for a limit gain of $10.00 per tbf, traders said.
September shot up the $10 daily limit to $346.70 per tbf and November ran up for a sharp gain of $9.70 to $344.00 per tbf.
The market had been under pressure recently from declining cash prices due to more-than-adequate lumber production and any reduction by a major producer should strengthen the cash market, they said.
